blocks.text: The module documentation establishes that migrated stores use this single psycopg entry point and explains low-privilege RLS, pool sizing, timeout, and telemetry decisions.
blocks.title: Pool and RLS boundary

blocks.text: DatabaseUnavailable carries a retry hint. _get_pool constructs the configured pool lazily, warm_pool waits for minimum connections, and _getconn_with_timeout translates PoolTimeout while counting outcomes.
blocks.title: Lazy pool and acquisition

blocks.text: get_pool_stats combines Redis-backed acquisition counters with psycopg's in-process statistics and reports a nullable exhaustion rate.
blocks.title: Pool metrics

blocks.text: cursor obtains a pooled connection, optionally sets app.current_user_id or app.trusted_internal, yields a dict-row cursor, commits on success, rolls back on error, and always returns the connection.
blocks.title: RLS-aware transaction cursor

blocks.text: Json re-exports psycopg's JSON wrapper for dict/list values passed to jsonb parameters.
blocks.title: JSON parameter adapter

gotchas: Missing DATABASE_URL fails when the pool is first requested.
Passing neither user_id nor trusted intentionally leaves RLS identity unset.
The module calls load_dotenv when available.
how_it_works: Creates and warms a lazy psycopg pool
Tracks immediate, waited, and exhausted acquisitions
Yields dict-row cursors with transaction and RLS handling
purpose: This module is the only database-pool boundary for the migrated stores. It lazily creates a psycopg pool from environment configuration, waits for available connections, records pool outcomes, applies RLS identity settings, and commits or rolls back each cursor context.
summary: Provides the shared psycopg connection pool, pool metrics, transaction cursor, and JSON adapter.

symbols.summary: Signals that the connection pool stayed exhausted through its configured wait.
Lazily creates and returns the shared configured psycopg connection pool.
Waits synchronously until the pool's minimum connections are established.
Acquires a pooled connection, records wait outcome, and translates exhaustion to DatabaseUnavailable.
Returns Redis acquisition counters and native psycopg pool statistics.
Yields a transactional dict-row cursor with optional RLS identity settings.
Wraps a Python value in psycopg's JSON adapter for query parameters.

unknowns: Database schema and RLS policy definitions are outside this module.
